task: Repair post-integration indexed-read and projected-match consumer regressions.
observation: The native generic indexed-read path rejected ORACLE-51 even though its exact local ownership facts were present: the branch RHS access was Effect::Write, because the borrowed vector element is mutated later. Separately, the Map-only projected-read resolver was called for direct Vector-index match projections and masked the existing unsupported nested-projection diagnostic.
impact: Using the typed Write fact to lower the indexed place restores ORACLE-51 without inference or cloning. Dispatching the projected-read authority only for a direct typed Map index keeps Map facts scoped to their checker operation; unsupported nested Vector projections now fail at the checked match consumer.

resolution.summary: Focused ORACLE-51 and projection dispatch regressions pass; broader clone authorization remains unresolved.
